title: Former Things Forgotten, All Things New
teaser: God's new heavens and new earth bring lasting joy, restored life, secure labor, answered prayer, and peace across all creation.

title: A Blessing Kept in the Cluster
teaser: God preserves a remnant for lasting joy while those who forsake him inherit a curse, each receiving a name that fits their destiny.

title: Here I Am to a Nation That Did Not Call
teaser: God's eager self-revelation exposes Israel's stubborn pursuit of pagan worship and guarantees a reckoning already written before him.

title: We Are Still the Clay
teaser: Israel appeals to God's fatherhood and creation, not its own merit, pleading that his anger not outlast the ruin of his temple.

title: No God Like This One
teaser: Israel's plea for a new theophany rests on what this God has always done for those who wait for him.

title: When the Throne Is Taken Away
teaser: Pride convinces us we are untouchable. God alone decides when that ends.

title: Rend the Heavens and Come Down
teaser: Confessing a wandering heart and a trampled sanctuary, Israel appeals to the one unchanging fact left to them: the Lord alone is their Father.

title: Carried Since the Days of Old
teaser: Israel recalls the compassion that saved them at the sea, the rebellion that grieved God's Spirit, and the deliverance still worth remembering.

title: The Warrior Who Trod Alone
teaser: The Lord's blood-stained garments testify that the same resolve which judges his enemies is the resolve that redeems his people.

title: Behold, Your Salvation Comes
teaser: The way is cleared, the Lord's proclamation reaches the earth, and Zion receives the names that declare her holy, redeemed, and sought after.
